messages:
Marcus Lee: Heads-up — Prism onboarding: observed p95 latency ~2.2s on /generate (US-West) and token spend is ~40% over their forecast. Usage profile: many short queries (<80 tokens) mixed with periodic long summarizations. Proactive options: 1) route short-context requests to a compact int4 variant, 2) enable session prefix/KV caching, 3) shift peak windows to a Dedicated pool. Thoughts?

Sarah Nguyen: That renewal is still early, but this is a red flag. We need a clean ROI story. Can we scope a 48h pilot and a clear savings projection for the renewal deck?

Elena Gomez: Agree on pilot. Also we need a quality checklist — hallucination/regression tests on representative prompts. I can assemble a 20-case prompt set.

Devon Park: Technical note: we can route deterministically based on token_count header from the client. Recommend fallback to standard-7b for >512 tokens to avoid edge regressions.

Marcus Lee: Draft routing policy for eng-runtime to use:
```json
{
  "selector": "token_count <= 100",
  "target_model": "prism-compact-3b-int4",
  "fallback": "prism-standard-7b",
  "cache": {"prefix_kv": true, "ttl_seconds": 600},
  "observability": ["latency_p95", "token_delta", "regression_rate"]
}
```

Devon Park: @eng-runtime-bot please schedule a 3% traffic canary for 24h starting 2026-06-02T18:00:00Z. Add automated checks: latency_p95, 5xx, and regression_rate against Elena's eval set with a 10% degrade threshold.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary scheduled: job_id=prism-canary-799999-01, start=2026-06-02T18:00:00Z, traffic=3%, duration=24h. Monitoring hooks configured (latency_p95, 5xx, regression_rate). Will post updates. :gear:

Sarah Nguyen: I'll hold renewal outreach until pilot finishes and we have savings numbers. sales-bot: Noted and added a calendar reminder on the customer timeline.

Elena Gomez: I'll publish the 20-case eval harness to the shared drive and run smoke tests immediately after canary completes. Will flag any functional regressions.

Devon Park: Ballpark cost impact if quality holds: ~28% token cost reduction (projected). I'll run precise sims and post numbers by EOD.

Marcus Lee: Perfect. I'll update the renewal risk tracker (status -> monitoring) and add this to next CS sync agenda. Thanks team — we'll reconvene after canary results. :rocket:
